spans.text: Battle finished. Enemy HQ 61% destroyed.
Supplementary exam evaluation—pass.
Exam progress 75%, loading next stage...
Everyone! You all did great!!
The moment the results are announced, CMR-30 rushes towards the other members of the group, barely containing her excitement.
Phew... that was close!
I was just thinking what I could possibly say if we didn't pass this time.
CMR-30 shakes her head.
Don't say that!
If I was of any use, maybe everyone would have had it a bit easier...
Talking about it doesn't get anything done. You gotta get a move on and get stronger.
The good news is that we've passed two stages and gotten half the marks. We're only a step away from passing the supplementary exam.
The bad news...
I know!
The last stage won't be easy.
Yes.
As everyone has certainly noticed, these three stages have gradually increased in difficulty.
We could handle stage two with a reasonable amount of effort, but we barely managed to pass the stage just now while giving it our all...
If the last stage follows that pattern, our odds aren't looking good.
Newbie, you need to be ready to get into the action.
Crackle—
The familiar electric noise begins emitting again, signifying the start of a new stage.
CMR-30 nervously holds her breath.
Pop.
Suddenly, the surroundings darken as if a switch has been flipped, and an oppressive veil of darkness falls over the group.
What's going on?! Did the power go out?
Stay calm. I think there's something over there.
A blurry silhouette faintly moves across a dark background in the direction Type 80 indicates.
The figure soon becomes clearer, and a strange face shows itself.
Can you really call yourself an elite Doll with performance like that?
Who are you?
Hehe, there's no point playing dumb with the Captain.
Huh? ...Captain?
The strange girl pays no further heed to Ceno's questions.
She withdraws her cold smile, but a frightening expression creeps into her mien.
Not even 80% damage... How disappointing.
Try again, then, until you're actually deserving of the title of an elite Doll.
Crackle. The girl's image disappears.
The group exchange confused looks, countless unanswered questions springing to their mind.
Where'd that one come from? An NPC? A copy of some other Doll's neural cloud?
Considering how enclosed this system is, my money would definitely be on her being part of the system.
Why'd she call herself "Captain", though?
And I swear I've seen her somewhere else before.
Oh no! Look at the system notice!!
The group only begin to notice a tiny string of blinking text at the bottom of the screen with CMR-30's panicked yelling...
Examination clearing progress—
Hey! This has to be a joke, right?
Progress cleared. Loading stage...
Zzp—Crackle—
Countless pixels emerge from the void, coalescing into a land of pure white extending into the distance.
A familiar snowfield, reaching the ends of the horizon.
This is... Zone S03, the first stage?!
What the hell, we're actually back.
The timer on the transparent barrier placidly counts down, as if everyone has been sent back through time to the very beginning.
Type 80 curses something foul under her breath, walking towards Thompson with a hand furiously clutching her weapon's barrel.
You believe me now, Thompson?
I told you from the beginning that this was definitely Kalina and the Commander's way of getting revenge! It was obvious they were going to screw with us this way!
The difficulty goes up whenever they feel like it, the progress clears itself when they feel like it... Why? Are we that easy to kick around?!
You go do whatever you want, I'm done!
Don't do this, Type 80!
Maybe it's a misunderstanding or a bug...
Please, Miss Ceno, help me out!
As if.
I told you l didn't want any part of this, but you had to drag me along...
I'm on Type 80's side as her teammate.
Why don't you two just do as we do and lie down until the Commander comes to bail us out?
But...!
Enough.
Thompson sighs.
Sorry, CMR-30, it's my fault you're here.
If I didn't insist on this, you would've already happily walked out of that room, right?
Thank you for staying with me until now. You've been an excellent new recruit.
Captain...
Thompson twists the corners of her mouth, turning to Type 80 and Ceno.
Sorry, I got ahead of myself.
But as Captain, I have to make good on my word and make up for my poor decision-making.
I'm not content just sitting here and waiting for the Commander's help—that's just never been my style.
...You're still going?
You've got a death wish, Thompson!
Thompson doesn't respond, only giving a chuckle as she lowers her head.
To the system, victory is just destroying more than 80% of the enemy's HQ, right?
If I come up with a way to get the jump on them, maybe that'll be enough!
You guys just wait here.
Captain, I'll come w—
Ratatat—
Before CMR-30 can finish speaking, Thompson rushes through the barrier...
BOOM—BOOM—
The massive rumbling returns, and a veritable wave of snow reaching towards the heavens surges towards the group.
This kinda... damn it!
Newbie, Ceno! Get to cover!
Unable to react in time, CMR-30 is dragged away by Type 80.
Looking back, Thompson's figure has long disappeared in the obfuscating snow...
